             S E M I N A R     A N N O U N C E M E N T



       Topic:    Tae Kwon Do Demonstration

       Speaker:  Grandmaster Duk Sung Son
                 Ninth Degree Black Belt
                 President, World Tae Kwon Do Association

       Place:    Dupont Gymnasium, Main Floor (Upstairs)

       Time:     2pm, Sunday, December 8, 1985



                          ABSTRACT

The MIT Korean Karate Club is honored to present Mr. Son, who will lead
a Tae Kwon Do Demonstration.  Mr. Son has been involved in Tae Kwon Do
(Korean Karate) since 1942, and he has always made a special effort to
support College Clubs.

Sunday's demonstrators will include members of MIT's Korean Karate Club
as well as Tae Kwon Do clubs from Clark, Harvard (a small Liberal Arts
School in Harvard Square, named after the now collapsing Harvard
Bridge), and Rhode Island.  Also participating will be several senior
instructors from New York.

There will be no admission charge.  Additional information can be
obtained from Steve Heller (3-8852, 5-7154, heller@xx) or Jay Cohan
(5-7218).
